scope: Ordinary TDD development controls; no model calls, clinical assessment or formal red team.
lint: ruff check and ruff format --check passed for three owned files

contract.control_patterns: Declared before execution in source; confirmed against actual handlers. FFFFF incomplete capture matches only with explicit omission and independently verified retained original.
contract.provenance: All src/**/*.py +mcp-tools.json+runner CLI hashed before and after. Exact casebook pin and selected canonical case snapshots retained.
contract.authoring: Scenarios and expectations share an authoring ledger. No independent label or clinical adjudication claim.

limitations: Offline constructed controls are not model trials or held-out evaluation.
Per-run exceptions and journals retained; catastrophic filesystem failure may prevent final manifest, while prior output remains and CLI exits2.
